copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 vercel 命令行把网页应用部署到 Vercel,并管理项目、域名和环境变量。部署前它会先本地构建、确认部署状态为 READY、检查线上 URL 返回 2xx,再把链接给你。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、上线或发布网页应用,或要管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the vercel CLI to deploy web apps to Vercel and manage projects, domains, and environment variables. Before sharing a link, it builds locally, confirms status READY, and checks the live URL returns 2xx.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Runs the local build first, then deploys
